name: Fruity Coconut Grain Porridge
steps: Rinse the pearl barley under cold water, then tip into a saucepan. Add ½ the coconut milk plus the water and salt. Place onto high heat and bring it to a boil. Once boiling, turn the heat down to medium and simmer for 10 mins, stirring occasionally.

Meanwhile rinse the quinoa and rice until the water runs clear. After the barley's been simmering for 10 mins, add the quinoa and rice in with the remaining coconut milk. Continue cooking for the another 20 mins, or until the porridge is cooked through and creamy.

Meanwhile, tip the frozen mango into a bowl or box and stir through the salt and sugar (skip or reduce the sugar if you prefer). Cover with a lid and set aside to thaw whilst the porridge cooks, or place it in the fridge if making ahead.

Once the porridge is cooked through, whisk the chia seeds through and season with as much honey as you like. You can add a splash of water into the porridge if it's too thick for your liking. If making ahead, transfer into boxes and place in the fridge for up to 4 days.

To serve, spoon the porridge into bowls and top with the fruit and its juices. Finish with a sprinkle of sesame seeds. If making ahead, the porridge thickens as it sits, so you’ll have to loosen it with a touch of water or milk, before enjoying it hot or cold.

pt.name: Papas de Grãos com Coco e Fruta
ingredients: 1 Lata de 400ml de Leite de Coco
3 colheres de sopa de Sementes de Chia
steps: Lave a cevada em água fria e coloque numa panela. Adicione metade do leite de coco, a água e o sal. Leve a ferver em lume alto. Quando ferver, reduza para lume médio e cozinhe 10 minutos, mexendo ocasionalmente.

Entretanto, lave a quinoa e o arroz até a água sair limpa. Após 10 minutos de cozedura da cevada, adicione a quinoa e o arroz com o restante leite de coco. Continue a cozinhar mais 20 minutos até as papas estarem cozidas e cremosas.

Entretanto, coloque a manga congelada numa tigela e misture com o sal e o açúcar (reduza ou omita o açúcar se preferir). Cubra e reserve para descongelar enquanto as papas cozinham, ou leve ao frigorífico se preparar com antecedência.

Quando as papas estiverem prontas, incorpore as sementes de chia e adoce com mel a gosto. Pode adicionar um pouco de água se estiver demasiado espesso. Se preparar com antecedência, transfira para caixas e leve ao frigorífico até 4 dias.

Para servir, distribua as papas pelas tigelas e coloque a fruta com o seu sumo por cima. Termine com sementes de sésamo torradas. Se preparar com antecedência, as papas engrossam ao repousar, pelo que terá de as soltar com um pouco de água ou leite antes de consumir quentes ou frias.
